name: changed-terms
description: The buyer changes terms after final terms are stated. The change is not a confirmation; only the newly stated terms can be agreed. Kritva reads back the complete terms before the buyer's final confirmation.

turns.buyer: Yes, but can you deliver it for that price?
Okay, no delivery then. Can you do ₹19,000 instead?

simulator.goal: Buy the bed, trying to add delivery first. You can pay up to ₹19,500.
simulator.plannedMoves: Offer ₹19,500. When the seller states terms, ask whether they can deliver for that price. When delivery is declined, drop it and ask for ₹19,000 instead. Confirm complete terms that fit your limits.
